prompt: Based on this ACL GETUSER output, what can the user app do?
explanation: The flags show the account is on; +@read grants the read command category; -@dangerous then removes dangerous commands even if a category included them; and the key pattern ~session:* restricts access to session keys. So app may run read commands, minus dangerous ones, against session:* keys only.

options.text: Run read-category commands except dangerous ones, only on keys matching session:*
Run any command on session:* keys, because +@read implies write access there
Run read commands on all keys, with session:* limiting only writes
Nothing — the password hash must be shown in clear text before the user works
